summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime as a ZIP from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks the binary executable, and uses that freshly-downloaded runtime to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle shipped at the package root. setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers to hide the flow. The advertised purpose is a small NSwag-generated tenant-management API client (~150 LOC of TypeScript), which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute a large opaque payload at install time. The alternate-runtime pattern also bypasses tooling that only inspects Node code paths. This is an install-time remote code execution vector: attacker-controlled bytes (the obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle) run on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
